name: Gozen 0-ji no Marginal
source:
The magician Arisa and her apprentice Leo live together.
Another peaceful day is over but...
Ohh!? The apprentices' situation is...!

[Translated from [url=http://hackmock.web.fc2.com/marginal/index.html]The Official site[/url]]
translation:
魔法师亚里沙和她的学徒利奥住在一起。
又一个平静的日子结束了，但是……
哦！？学徒们的处境是……！

[翻译自[url=http://hackmock.web.fc2.com/marginal/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
